name: Everlaw
description: Combine Everlaw's powerful AI and analytics with your Claude-based workflows. Connect Everlaw to Claude to search, analyze, and pull case insights in seconds—right from your documents. Stay in control and move faster on live matters without risking confidentiality or defensibility.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Everlaw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Everlaw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.everlaw.com/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Everlaw MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everlaw provides these MCP tools: GetProjectSearchResult, PostProjectSearch, and GetProjectBinders.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Everlaw?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Everlaw in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Everlaw requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Everlaw is developed by Everlaw. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
